UserPublicProfile.title: UserPublicProfile
UserPublicProfile.description: Public profile metadata for an authenticated SkyNex AI user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document owner.

isDemo.description: Indicates if this is the restricted Evaluator Demo account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII document storing the user email address.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created.

DemoAuditLog.title: DemoAuditLog
DemoAuditLog.description: Isolated sandbox activity log for the Evaluator Demo account.

uid.description: UID of the demo user who triggered the sandbox event.

action.description: Demo action performed in the sandbox.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of the demo event.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores non-PII public profile metadata for authenticated users.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Isolated PII storage for user email address accessible strictly by owner.

/demo_sandbox_logs/{logId}.description: Isolated sandbox collection for Evaluator Demo sessions, separated from production user data.
